racialTraits.name: Draconic Ancestry
racialTraits.description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon from the Draconic Ancestry table. Your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type.

racialTraits.name: Breath Weapon
racialTraits.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy.

racialTraits.name: Damage Resistance
racialTraits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your draconic ancestry.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Dwarven Resilience
racialTraits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against poison, and you have resistance against poison damage.

racialTraits.name: Dwarven Combat Training
racialTraits.description: You have proficiency with the battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, and warhammer.

racialTraits.name: Tool Proficiency
racialTraits.description: You gain proficiency with the artisan’s tools of your choice: smith’s tools, brewer’s supplies, or mason’s tools.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Accustomed to twilit forests and the night sky, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Keen Senses
racialTraits.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

racialTraits.name: Fey Ancestry
racialTraits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

racialTraits.name: Trance
racialTraits.description: Elves don’t need to sleep. Instead, they meditate deeply, remaining semiconscious, for 4 hours a day.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Accustomed to life underground, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Gnome Cunning
racialTraits.description: You have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Thanks to your elf heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Fey Ancestry
racialTraits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can’t put you to sleep.

racialTraits.name: Skill Versatility
racialTraits.description: You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Thanks to your orc blood, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Menacing
racialTraits.description: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill.

racialTraits.name: Relentless Endurance
racialTraits.description: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead.

racialTraits.name: Savage Attacks
racialTraits.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon’s damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage of the critical hit.

racialTraits.name: Lucky
racialTraits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

racialTraits.name: Brave
racialTraits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

racialTraits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
racialTraits.description: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

racialTraits.name: Extra Language
racialTraits.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

racialTraits.name: Darkvision
racialTraits.description: Thanks to your infernal heritage, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions.

racialTraits.name: Hellish Resistance
racialTraits.description: You have resistance to fire damage.

racialTraits.name: Infernal Legacy
racialTraits.description: You know the thaumaturgy cantrip. When you reach 3rd level, you can cast the hellish rebuke spell as a 2nd-level spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. When you reach 5th level, you can cast the darkness spell once with this trait and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.
